purpose: Secure the 200,572,944 longtail universe while Search Console catches up by mapping every traffic avenue to proof routes, source trails, Supabase behavior, and promote/hold decisions.
guardrails: Do not claim Google rank movement until Search Console rows, impressions, clicks, and indexed routes prove it.
Do not expand a lane because it sounds exciting; expand only after Supabase/Search Console shows behavior.
Use external posts only where the answer is useful, relevant, and human-readable.

masterKeywordLock.policy: DigitalHut reads the 200M longtail universe as full-system claim lanes. Google receives crawlable proof routes, a 50,000 URL discovery sitemap, and public JSON coverage instead of millions of duplicate thin URLs.

scoredAvenues.label: Full-System Pass-By Post
scoredAvenues.exactPostAngle: 2026 dapp entertainment observatory: video watching + 3D Model View + podcast/source moments + live analytics in one interface.
scoredAvenues.action: Lead with the full dapp alternative, then push people to proof/source routes instead of only the homepage.

scoredAvenues.label: GLB And 3D Model View Communities
scoredAvenues.exactPostAngle: Watch a video session while the 3D Model View opens, rotates, zooms, and explains the model as part of the episode.
scoredAvenues.action: Use GLB as the strongest second-action hook, but keep every trail tied to the full DigitalHut system.

scoredAvenues.label: Mundane Life Search Capture
scoredAvenues.exactPostAngle: Everyday searches can become a useful video + source + 3D context session instead of a dead tab.
scoredAvenues.action: Promote only the mundane lanes that earn search or proof events; hold filler variants until behavior appears.

scoredAvenues.label: Podcast Source Trust Moments
scoredAvenues.exactPostAngle: Podcast/source moments interrupt the video only when they add authority, then return the viewer to the observatory session.
scoredAvenues.action: Use podcast as trust proof after the video/GLB hook; avoid making it the lead lane until source opens appear.

scoredAvenues.label: Research And Developer Proof
scoredAvenues.exactPostAngle: DigitalHut is not a static site: it has Vercel, Supabase, Google, sitemap packets, GLB rendering, podcast/source moments, and measurable event receipts.
scoredAvenues.action: Use developer proof to win credibility, then wait for Search Console rows before expanding technical keywords.

scoredAvenues.label: Market And Business Side Lane
scoredAvenues.exactPostAngle: Market topics become a company video/source/3D environment read, but remain a side arm of the entertainment observatory.
scoredAvenues.action: Keep market available; do not let it pull the system away from the full entertainment dapp lane.

nextBestAction: Use the full-system pass-by post and GLB model-view communities as the next natural traffic positions, but the first real explosion trigger is proof/source opens or new Search Console query rows.
promotionRule: Promote a lane only when at least one of these moves: Search Console impressions, proof route opens, source/backlink opens, search runs, GLB plays from non-preview origins, podcast source plays, or autoplay starts from public candidates.
